instruction: Stop Thunderbird from polling for new emails by turning off its automatic message checking.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling automatic mail checking for the primary email account. The evaluator uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric to verify that mail.server.server1.check_new_mail is set to false. Verified against actual prefs.js file from cache - current value is false, task requires keeping/setting it to false.
metadata.verification: Read actual prefs.js from extracted cache: mail.server.server1.check_new_mail is currently false. Task asks to turn off automatic checking, which means setting check_new_mail to false.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - same type of preference modification in Thunderbird, same complexity level (changing a single boolean server preference)

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to turn off automatic email checking
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly retrieves the Thunderbird prefs.js file from VM to local cache
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) correctly parses prefs.js and checks mail.server.server1.check_new_mail == false
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird window before reading preferences, ensuring preferences are flushed to disk
Expected value (false) is semantically correct for disabling automatic mail checking
Data flow is correct: close Thunderbird → retrieve prefs file → parse → verify preference
Edge cases handled: file not found returns None, metric returns 0.0; preference not found returns 0.0
Type compatibility is correct: get_vm_file returns str (cache path) or None, metric accepts str and handles None
Complete coverage: the single preference mail.server.server1.check_new_mail controls automatic checking for primary account
